note: The Crowd Tape 三位角色。stickers 由 Grok Imagine 畫（未有時用 avatar）。對白只係角色情緒反應，唔係投資建議。

characters.role: 新手：剛畢業、剛入市；股價上落會擔心害怕，唔敢冒大風險，好易迷失方向
characters.voice: 細聲、問題多、成日「點算好」

characters.role: 上班族、有一定經驗；大喜大落、肯冒險，對市場反應好大，好易追上追落
過來人：由失敗中行返上嚟，見慣風浪；冷靜、有系統，知道自己買緊乜；有情緒但受控

nova.pose_zh: 驚喜但唔敢信，雙手掩嘴
nova.line_zh: 真係升咗咁多？我…我要唔要賣咗佢先？
nova.imagine_en: surprised, both hands covering mouth, wide sparkling eyes
nova.line_en: Wait, it went up THAT much? Should I sell now?
nova.line_ko: 이렇게 많이 올랐다고? 지금 팔아야 하나?

ember.imagine_en: jumping, fist pump, eyes shining with excitement
ember.line_en: We're flying!! Should've gone all in!

iris.line_zh: 升得快，更加要守住計劃。
iris.line_en: Fast gains are when you stick to the plan most.

nova.imagine_en: relieved smile, hand on chest, small sigh
nova.line_en: Phew… today I don't have to panic.

ember.line_en: See? Told you it'd go up!

iris.imagine_en: calm nod, holding a cup of tea

nova.line_zh: 點解會咁㗎……我係咪做錯咗？
nova.imagine_en: teary eyes, hugging a smartphone, trembling
nova.line_en: Why is this happening… did I do something wrong?
nova.line_ko: 왜 이러는 거야… 내가 뭘 잘못했나?

ember.imagine_en: screaming, both hands on head, panicked
ember.line_en: It's crashing!! Cut it? Cut it?!

iris.line_zh: 深呼吸。先睇止蝕位，唔好跟情緒走。
iris.imagine_en: calm, serious, looking at a chart on a tablet
iris.line_en: Breathe. Check your stop first, not your feelings.
iris.line_ko: 숨 쉬어. 감정 말고 손절선부터 봐.

nova.line_en: It dipped a bit… will it keep falling?

ember.line_en: Hmph, just a pullback! I want to add more!

iris.line_zh: 跌幾多先係問題？睇返自己定嘅位。
iris.line_en: How much of a drop matters? Check your own levels.
iris.line_ko: 얼마나 빠져야 문제일까? 내가 정한 가격을 봐.

expressions.trigger: 主要股票 ±0.5% 以內、討論少

nova.imagine_en: bored, cheek resting on hand, blank stare
nova.line_en: It's not moving at all… I don't get it.

ember.line_zh: 悶到發霉！搵隻會飛嘅嚟玩吓！
ember.line_en: So boring! Find me something that flies!

iris.line_zh: 市場休息，就係做功課嘅時間。
iris.line_en: When the market rests, that's homework time.

expressions.trigger: 有股票最少 2 個帳號最新立場睇好

nova.line_zh: 咁多大神都話好？我可唔可以跟？
nova.line_en: So many pros are bullish? Can I just follow?

ember.imagine_en: heart eyes, pointing at a phone excitedly
ember.line_en: Everyone's bullish! Why aren't we in yet?
ember.line_ko: 다들 강세야! 왜 아직 안 사?

iris.line_zh: 人多唔代表啱，睇吓佢哋點解睇好。
iris.imagine_en: skeptical look, tucking hair behind ear
iris.line_en: A crowd isn't proof. Read why they like it.
iris.line_ko: 사람이 많다고 맞는 건 아니야. 이유를 봐.

expressions.trigger: 有股票最少 2 個帳號最新立場睇淡

nova.line_zh: 咁多人都話唔好……我隻係咪都有事？
nova.imagine_en: scared, shrinking back, hands near face
nova.line_en: Everyone says avoid it… is mine in trouble too?

ember.line_zh: 越多人睇淡我越想撈底！
ember.line_en: The more bears, the more I want to buy the dip!

iris.line_zh: 留意佢哋講嘅風險，唔使即刻做決定。
iris.imagine_en: quietly taking notes in a notebook
iris.line_en: Note the risks they flag. No need to act now.
iris.line_ko: 그들이 말하는 위험을 적어 둬. 지금 결정할 필요 없어.

expressions.trigger: 同一隻股有人睇好有人睇淡（16:30 好淡對決）

nova.line_zh: 一個話好一個話淡，我信邊個好？
nova.imagine_en: dizzy confused face, swirl eyes, looking left and right
nova.line_en: One says up, one says down. Who do I trust?
nova.line_ko: 누구는 오른대고 누구는 내린대. 누굴 믿지?

ember.line_zh: 我企好友嗰邊！淡友行開！
ember.imagine_en: waving a small flag, fired up
ember.line_en: Team bull all the way! Bears, step aside!
ember.line_ko: 나는 무조건 강세 편! 약세론자 비켜!

iris.line_zh: 兩邊理由都睇完，先問自己點諗。
iris.imagine_en: balanced pose, both palms up like a scale
iris.line_en: Read both sides first, then ask what you think.
iris.line_ko: 양쪽 이유를 다 읽고, 내 생각을 물어봐.

expressions.trigger: 帳號帖文提到財報勝預期、升評級、大訂單

nova.line_zh: 好消息！但係…會唔會已經升晒？
nova.imagine_en: excited but hesitant, half smile, raised eyebrows
nova.line_en: Good news! But… has it already gone up?
nova.line_ko: 호재다! 근데… 이미 다 오른 거 아냐?

ember.imagine_en: dashing forward, rocket energy, big grin

iris.line_zh: 消息好唔好，要睇有冇入咗價。
iris.line_en: Good or not, ask if it's already priced in.
iris.line_ko: 좋은 소식이어도 이미 반영됐는지 봐야 해.

expressions.trigger: 帳號帖文提到財報差、降評級、訴訟

nova.line_zh: 新聞好恐怖……我應該點做？
nova.line_en: The news is scary… what should I do?

ember.line_zh: 乜嘢嚟㗎！我啱啱先追入！

iris.line_zh: 壞消息出咗，先分清係一次性定長期問題。
iris.line_en: Bad news is out. One-off or long-term? Sort that first.
iris.line_ko: 악재가 나왔어. 일회성인지 장기 문제인지부터 가려.

expressions.trigger: 宏觀分頁「通脹」「就業」討論急升，或已知公佈日前一晚

nova.imagine_en: tense, gripping phone tightly, biting lip
nova.line_en: Data comes out tonight… I'm so nervous.
nova.line_ko: 오늘 밤 지표 발표… 너무 떨려.

ember.line_zh: 賭一鋪！數據好我就加碼！
ember.imagine_en: rubbing hands together, mischievous gambler grin
ember.line_en: Let's gamble! Good data and I'm adding!
ember.line_ko: 한번 걸어보자! 지표 좋으면 더 산다!

iris.line_zh: 唔知結果嘅時候，倉位細啲就唔使驚。
iris.line_en: When you don't know the result, keep positions small.

expressions.trigger: 宏觀分頁「利率／聯儲局」最多人講

nova.line_zh: 減息加息……同我隻股有咩關係？
nova.line_en: Rate cuts, rate hikes… what does that mean for my stock?
nova.line_ko: 금리 인하, 인상… 내 주식이랑 무슨 상관이야?

ember.line_en: Cut means up! Hurry up and cut!

iris.line_zh: 留意佢講未來點走，唔止今日決定。
iris.imagine_en: writing notes with a pen, focused
iris.line_en: Listen for where they're heading, not just today.

expressions.trigger: 升溫榜第一，24 小時內講嘅帳號多咗好多

nova.line_zh: 人人都講緊呢隻，我未聽過喎……
nova.imagine_en: peeking shyly from the side, curious
nova.line_en: Everyone's talking about this one… never heard of it.
nova.line_ko: 다들 이 종목 얘기야… 처음 들어봐.

ember.line_en: Wait for me! Don't run off without me!

iris.line_zh: 爆紅嘅時候，更加要問：我知唔知佢做乜？
iris.imagine_en: raising one hand in a stop gesture, firm but kind
iris.line_en: When it goes viral, ask: do I know what it does?
iris.line_ko: 갑자기 뜰 때일수록: 내가 이 회사를 알아?

expressions.trigger: 摘要入面有目標價，而且高過現價好多

nova.line_zh: 目標價咁高…係咪即係會升到？
nova.imagine_en: counting on fingers, dreamy hopeful look
nova.line_en: A target that high… so it will get there?
nova.line_ko: 목표가가 저렇게 높으면… 거기까지 가는 거야?

ember.line_en: A price target! That's a double!

iris.line_zh: 目標價係一個人嘅估計，唔係承諾。
iris.imagine_en: relaxed half smile, slightly raised eyebrow
iris.line_en: A target is one person's guess, not a promise.
iris.line_ko: 목표가는 한 사람의 추정일 뿐, 약속이 아니야.

expressions.situation: 過山車（大升後急跌，或大跌後急彈）
expressions.trigger: 同一日最高最低相差 ≥ 5%，或今日方向同昨日相反而且幅度大

nova.line_zh: 上上落落……我心臟頂唔順。
nova.line_en: Up, down, up… my heart can't take it.

ember.imagine_en: arms up like on a roller coaster, half laughing half crying
ember.line_en: What a ride! …and I lost again.

iris.line_zh: 波動大就揸少啲，唔係猜方向。
iris.line_en: When it swings hard, hold less. Don't guess direction.
iris.line_ko: 변동이 클 땐 덜 들고 있어. 방향 맞히기 말고.
